basePrompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a pixel-sharp, production-quality desktop app UI design proposal for ScholarNoteLM, a Chinese academic literature research app. Landscape 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Flat full-screen app screenshot, straight-on, no laptop, no desk, no perspective, no presentation framing, no outside caption. Reference 1 is the EXISTING page for functional inventory, NOT its visual style. Radically redesign its hierarchy following the explicit design system below. Preserve existing functions and actual corpus counts, no invented scientific data, no invented charts.
DESIGN SYSTEM: modern restrained macOS-inspired professional academic application; tactile precision of Apple Notes/Finder, editorial care, not a SaaS dashboard. Almost entirely paper white #FAFAFB and #FFFFFF with neutral silver sidebar #F0F1F3, graphite #1D1D1F type, secondary #62666E. Small ink-blue #3157D5 accents ONLY for main action and active indicator/links; selection wash #E9EEF9. Hairline #DEE0E5 dividers. No green, teal, sage, purple gradient, colorful cards, glass glare, decorative hero, leaf icon, orbit art, marketing slogans, huge pill controls, deep shadows, stacked card-inside-card layouts. Modest 7px button radii, 10px panels; panels mostly unboxed with separators. Thin 1.5px consistent monochrome outline icons. SF Pro/PingFang-style Chinese sans UI, crisp readable body 14-16px equivalent, metadata minimum12px, weights400/500/600, 26px page title. Academic serif only for article reading title/body when appropriate; never serif numeric dashboard metrics.
Shared shell: left navigation 184px out of 1280 logical width, full height neutral silver. Small monochrome book mark and ScholarNoteLM wordmark; compact project picker 肠道菌群与免疫调节, search shortcut. Main top bar48px, restrained breadcrumb and small saved indicator. No slogan footer or PERSONAL branding. Main region ample but efficient 24px gutters, clear alignment. One primary filled blue button per action context, other buttons white with thin border or plain icon. Toolbars compact and consistent. No fake macOS traffic lights because screenshot is app content area.

Chinese text should be accurately typeset, English paper titles can be natural exact scholarly titles. This is a visual proposal, not a depiction of executed new research.
